speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hundred yards, and the whole street is backs.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Look at the horse, not the plumes. A law-student king, and he sits a hired horse as if the horse had read the proclamation.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art studying the seat. I am looking at the porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He will dine a play-prince at his table and shut the door on a player. Mark me, that is the City.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The Night of Errors. We laughed then, and the horse is doing it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We laughed at that night, and I will not tell it over. I have marked you, Mistress. I am not going in.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nor I. The dinner is his. Torch-smoke, and the brass of those trumpets, over a man who will not know we were here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir John has not looked this way. He will not.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A furred gown, and a straight face, and a king made of students. When they have gone in, the street is ours again, and none the wiser.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we let them go in. I have a walk down to the Cross Keys before a play that is not mine to act.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will walk down with thee. Leave the prince his dinner.
